use: Original design exploration, not product evidence

entries.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: desktop opening-section design concept for the I-9 Skills promotional website.
Design a polished original 1440x1000 desktop web concept for builders managing agent skills. This is the first of four coordinated section references; downstream sections are an ink lifecycle band, a useful catalog list, and installation plus evidence. Render only the opening viewport with a small preview of the next band. All visible UI will later be code-native.
Art direction: contemporary architectural field manual, airy and precise. Canvas is pale paper-white #F7F9F2, text forest ink #14231A, single acid-lime #D7F46B accent. Large geometric sans typography resembling Arial/Helvetica Neue with disciplined 0.98 headline leading and deliberate negative space. Avoid gradient, glow, bento/card grids, rounded nested frames, badges, eyebrow text, generic AI illustrations, fake dashboards, customer logos, invented claims or metrics.
Header: textual wordmark "I-9 Skills" at left. Quiet navigation "Workflow", "Catalog", "Install", "Docs". Right language links "EN PT ES". Thin bottom rule.
Hero in open two-column layout: left large exact headline "Better skills.\nBy design." with "By design." forest green italic serif as a deliberate editorial accent. Supporting copy exact: "Create, evaluate and evolve agent skills. One responsibility. One reviewable output." Primary dark rectangular button exact "Explore the catalog" with a small outlined arrow icon. Secondary text link exact "Choose your install path".
Right: an original beautifully lit sculptural still life of four modular interlocking rectangular package blocks, rounded just slightly, floating above a very light surface. Matte forest green, acid-lime and ivory materials; understated paper edges and fine inset slots communicate complete skill packages. No text on the objects, no robot, no person, no third-party branding. Crisp directional shadows, strong object form. The artwork must be separable later as a standalone original asset and blend into the exact page background without a color overlay. Keep it about 48 percent of hero width, not overwhelming the copy.
At the lower edge show a small horizontal restrained facts rail "24 focused meta-skills" "Apache-2.0" "Portable core" and a dark forest band beginning below. 24 is the verified current catalog count, the only numeric product statement.
Button and nav text readable at native size. Intentional reusable components, sharp corners with subtle 4px radius. Practical HTML/CSS implementation, no decorative UI. Show a complete readable opening concept, not a cropped header.

Use case: ui-mockup. Fresh large readable desktop section concept for I-9 Skills, not a crop or modified screenshot. The reference image supplies the exact visual system only: #F7F9F2 paper-white, #14231A forest ink, #D7F46B acid-lime, oversized disciplined Arial/Helvetica sans paired with restrained italic serif emphasis, 64px desktop gutters, thin rules, open layout, no gradients/glows, no bento/card grid, no invented metrics, no fake customers or provider logos. This is one section of a coordinated complete website: opening → lifecycle → catalog → install → evidence/footer. All UI text/controls later code-native. Do not include the hero again or unrelated new sections. Native screenshot must have clear text and practical HTML/CSS anatomy.
Render the lifecycle section as a spacious dark forest-green full-width band, with the heading at upper left "Start anywhere.\nImprove deliberately." Make the second line understated italic serif. At right aligned short supporting copy exact "Keep what works. Change one responsibility at a time." Below, four open equal columns separated by thin muted green vertical rules, not cards. Each column has small acid-lime ordinal "01", "02", "03", "04", white large labels "Create", "Verify", "Improve", "Distribute". Body copy respectively "Find the job. Research the domain. Build a complete package.", "Evaluate behavior, security and declared compatibility.", "Audit what exists. Keep evidence. Evolve the smallest useful change.", "Choose an approved package and a deliberate distribution path." Each column has an understated underlined native link respectively "skill-authoring", "skill-evaluator", "skills-audit", "skill-publication", with tiny consistent outline arrow. Maintain clean contrast and readable scale. Lower edge returns to paper white with heading preview "Find the skill for the job." Show useful static content, not an animation storyboard.

Use case: ui-mockup. Fresh large readable desktop section concept for I-9 Skills, not a crop or modified screenshot. The reference image supplies the exact visual system only: #F7F9F2 paper-white, #14231A forest ink, #D7F46B acid-lime, oversized disciplined Arial/Helvetica sans paired with restrained italic serif emphasis, 64px desktop gutters, thin rules, open layout, no gradients/glows, no bento/card grid, no invented metrics, no fake customers or provider logos. This is one section of a coordinated complete website: opening → lifecycle → catalog → install → evidence/footer. All UI text/controls later code-native. Do not include the hero again or unrelated new sections. Native screenshot must have clear text and practical HTML/CSS anatomy.
Render catalog section on paper-white. Large upper-left heading exact "Find the skill\nfor the job." Short supporting sentence below exact "Focused packages for the full life of an agent skill." Right-aligned link "View source catalog". Below a wide accessible search input labeled "Search skills", placeholder "Name, responsibility or keyword", with simple search outline icon. Under it a single open filter line with "All", "Create", "Evaluate", "Manage", "Evolve", "Distribute"; All is selected with dark background small rectangle, no pills. Right count "24 skills".
Below render open, spacious table-like rows, thin gray-green horizontal dividers. Each row left small colored skill-icon area, exact canonical name and exact description in readable regular sans, right category and an outlined arrow link.
Rows:
"skill-authoring" — "Use to author or revise a focused skill package from a goal and design, coordinating discovery, synthesis, and evaluation through companion skills. Use skills-discovery for search alone." category "Create".
"skill-design" — "Use to resolve a skill's responsibility, interface, and design tradeoffs from a brief or merge plan before authoring. It does not discover sources or implement the package." category "Create".
"skill-evaluator" — "Use to evaluate a skill package against frozen behavioral cases and a baseline, returning evidence and a readiness verdict. It does not author fixes or publish the skill." category "Evaluate".
"skills-audit" — "Use to audit a collection of installed or authored skills for inventory, provenance, validation, policy, and drift, producing one findings report." category "Manage".
No fake pagination: this design detail shows first four of an ordinary scrollable fully rendered 24-row catalog. No giant frame, rounded cards or nested wrappers. Text must be readable without zoom at native size.

This is one section of a coordinated complete website: opening → lifecycle → catalog → install → evidence/footer. All UI text/controls later code-native. Render the final installation and evidence section, large enough to read all text. On paper-white use left editorial heading "Your agent.\nYour install path." with second line italic serif, and supporting copy "Portable skills, a host plugin, or the toolkit CLI. Choose what you need."
Right region contains three vertically stacked open install lanes divided by thin rules. Each lane includes bold title, one sentence, a dark forest rectangular command block with lime monospace command text, and a small native "Copy" button.
Lane title "Portable packages", body "Install the skills for your chosen agent. Host hooks are a separate integration.", command exact "npx skills add https://github.com/i-9-ai/skills --skill '*' --yes".
Lane title "Codex plugin", body "Skills, session hook and catalog MCP. Requires Codex CLI and Node.js 24+.", command exact two lines "codex plugin marketplace add i-9-ai/skills --ref main" and "codex plugin add i9-skills@i9-skills".
Lane title "Toolkit CLI", body "Run catalog and skill management commands with Node.js 24+.", command exact "npx --yes @i-9.ai/skills catalog overview". This is proposed registry copy pending confirmed publication; no downloaded count or release badge.
Below a full-width subtle acid-lime band with exact heading "Evidence before confidence." Three open columns with title/body: "Portable core" / "Agent Skills Markdown and bundled resources."; "Explicit limits" / "Structural checks and provider pilots cover different things."; "Still experimental" / "No universal compatibility or production-quality claim." Add native link "Read compatibility and evidence".
Footer open thin rule, text wordmark "I-9 Skills", links "GitHub", "Documentation", "Apache-2.0", right language "EN PT ES". No testimonials, forms, trackers, new proof claims or extra sections.

Stacked primary button "Explore the catalog" and secondary native link "Choose your install path". Below show original four-block artwork in a generous centered landscape area, no overlay, no text on artwork.
Then a small facts rail "24 focused meta-skills" "Apache-2.0" "Portable core" stacked or neatly wrapped, followed by the top of the dark forest lifecycle section with heading "Start anywhere." and italic "Improve deliberately.", sentence "Keep what works. Change one responsibility at a time." and the first step "01 Create". Mobile UI must be readable and intentionally designed, no horizontal scrolling. Show the full requested responsive section continuation rather than header-only crop.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: standalone transparent hero artwork. From the referenced I-9 Skills website concept, extract and faithfully recreate ONLY its sculptural modular-package still life: the four interlocking matte rectangular blocks, forest ink green, pale ivory, and acid-lime, softly rounded corners, inset horizontal slots, subtle paper texture, exact isometric form, proportions, realistic directed lighting and restrained soft contact shadow. Keep the same orientation and visual identity. No page UI, no heading, no nav, no button, no text, no logo, no watermark, no background plate. Genuine transparent background with transparent pixels around the isolated object. Plenty of clearance around the complete object so no edge is cropped. The shadows should be subtle and usable over the page's #F7F9F2 paper-white background; preserve all block detail.
